merging: GitHub projects: default 'you press Merge' with a one-click Merge in the app (dependency order, merge commits only, the safe merge step); per-project option 'merge automatically after review'; 'Take this work out' (revert PR naming later tasks that built on it). Each task's agent keeps committing on its own branch.
autopilot_repo: Autopilot asks before creating a repository (no silent creation).
local_copy: The PC's copy of a repository project refreshes after every merge (in the app or on GitHub), so Files/Open folder show the merged work.
local_only_folder: A 'Local only' folder inside a repository project: never uploaded, agents can use it.
pr_preview: 'Open this version' on a waiting PR: its files on the PC to try before merging.
own_folder: No (do not link the person's own working folder).
credentials: Q2 yes: the person's order decides; another credential only when the first cannot do the task properly (plan card says why); refused-key detection and one card; wait at a limit with the reset time and start by itself; honest words.
budgets: Q3 yes: 80/20 wrap-up per run, paused outcome (no review, no failed try), code-side save with 'where I stopped / left to do', resume from it, card naming the real limit with 'Continue (CHF N more)' starting the next session at once, cancel sets work aside and names stuck dependents, subscription stop really stops Claude Code, better estimates and caching.
web_search: Q5 yes: Anthropic web search on the API key (capped per task), Forerunner's page reader on both credentials, sourced only after the page was opened, information wrapper on the subscription path too.
sites: Q6 fix it: any public website by default; per-project 'only these' or 'never these' lists, same on both credentials; never this PC or the home network; fix the inverted list, subdomains, silent drops, localhost hole; a settings row and a project-page line.
ctrl_click: Q7 yes: Ctrl/Shift-click on the app's own links acts like a normal click.
